summary: HDFC Bank furnished a 6-K on September 30, 2026, disclosing the superannuation of Mr. Sudhir Kumar Jha as Group Head - Legal and Group General Counsel, effective close of business that day, ending a 22-year HDFC Group association. The filing is a routine succession notice: Mr. Jigar Shah, General Counsel Designate, assumed the General Counsel role on October 1, 2026, as previously intimated on June 29, 2026. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or price mechanics are stated. This is an orderly planned retirement rather than a forced departure, so no special-situation or risk-arb angle applies.
